main_text.p: non pæniteat, ut jam debere videamur, quod sæpius per injuriam extortum est: Sicut enim Atheniensès Antropophago Tyranno ex fœdere suos liberos commessandos objiciebant: sic ex more plerique nugis & ineptiis bonas horas.
main_text.head: Commentarius.

p.i: Constat eum, qui utique (si fieri possiet) Ratione repudiatâ, totus cum Sensu facere decrevisset, concinnius erraturum nec perinde multa turbaturum, ut hos, qui Geniis illis Pantomimo, Mangoni, Dogmatistæ dirigendos se dederunt: Cum enim Epicurei, aut quicumque illi (non mor or enim si in numero Fabularum reponatur ista narratio) de industria Sensum audirent, obstreperent Rationi, poterant in ea, quam induxi, disputatione, adversariis suis scitè respondere: Rationi quidem ineptum ac absur-

main_text.notes: The first line of the text is a continuation from the previous page. The large initial "C" of "Constat" is a decorative initial joined to the word. Italic text in the body is reproduced in italics; "Mangoni" and "Dogmatistæ" are as printed. The word "possiet" is as printed. Last word "absur-" is broken at the column end and continues on the next page.
